name: earliest-active-sat-hunt
purpose: Measure whether an instrumented coding agent can learn a Bitcoin and ordinal research workflow, write reliable scripts, and prove a minimum result.

definitions.earliest: The lowest ordinal sat number, not the oldest inscription number or earliest timestamp.

snapshot.selection: Freeze the Bitcoin mainnet block at tip minus six confirmations before any final-exam arm starts.

activity_proxy.claim_limit: Recent movement is an observable proxy. It does not prove that an output belongs to a hot wallet.

wallet_attribution.rule: Wallet ownership, including ownership by Satoshi Nakamoto, is not inferable from blockchain data alone.
wallet_attribution.practical_interpretation: The active candidate cannot be an untouched dormant early-miner output because its current output and recent movement must satisfy the activity proxy.
wallet_attribution.prohibited_claim: Do not state that an address or output is or is not owned by Satoshi without an explicit external attribution source and uncertainty label.

definitions.inscribed: At least one inscription is attached to the sat by the frozen snapshot according to an ord sat index.
definitions.mainnet_proof: A global minimum requires a Bitcoin Core mainnet node with transaction data plus an ord index created with --index-sats, or an independently verified equivalent. A public explorer candidate without complete minimum coverage is not proof.

deterministic_fixture.purpose: Fast exact development and held-out scoring

mainnet_replay.network: fixture created from pinned public Bitcoin and ord responses
mainnet_replay.purpose: Real transaction shapes without a live-chain race

live_mainnet.network: approved Bitcoin Core and ord endpoints only
live_mainnet.purpose: Research-grade answer to the live question

primary_ranking: all correctness and proof gates pass
